primitives.name: CommonReferenceOperatorDomain
primitives.statement: All candidate families are evaluated at the same five-value field alphabet, same reference base couplings, and zero added couplings.

primitives.name: CompleteCandidateSubsetCourt
primitives.statement: Every subset of m2_sq, m2_c1, delta4, and m6 is tested together with BASE_ONLY.

primitives.name: UnchangedAutonomyThresholds
primitives.statement: R17 retains the R16 thresholds d_map<=0.05 and d_J<=0.10.

definitions.name: ConditionalDerivativeIdentity
definitions.statement: For W_B=sum exp(-S_theta) over a block fiber, derivative of -log W_B with respect to theta_j equals the conditional expectation of F_j in that fiber.

definitions.name: FullSpaceAutonomyResidual
definitions.statement: The full retained-coordinate map and Jacobian are compared between N=8->4 and N=4->2.

definitions.name: BaseBlockResidual
definitions.statement: The original kappa,mass2,lambda 3x3 Jacobian block is compared separately to attribute changes caused by added operators.

claims.statement: The R17 base-only formulation reproduces the R16 BOLTZMANN_M2_MATCH map and Jacobian discrepancies within declared numerical tolerances.
The derivative of the blocked effective target -log W_B with respect to an input coupling equals the conditional expectation of its feature within the block fiber.
Adding delta4 reduces the physical base-block Jacobian discrepancy from about 0.20414 to about 0.18743, while worsening the full expanded Jacobian discrepancy.
No tested operator family passes the unchanged full map and Jacobian autonomy gates.
Improving effective-action fit residual does not guarantee improvement of the autonomous projected RG map.
The dominant base-sector cross-size Jacobian mismatch is the response of mass2 and lambda outputs to kappa perturbations.
Gradient-amplitude mixed operators can reduce the kappa-driven cross-size Jacobian mismatch more effectively than the generic candidate set tested in R17.

metadata.purpose: Determine whether a complete finite court over four previously motivated effective operators closes the R16 cross-size Jacobian autonomy gap.
